query: SELECT set_config('statement_timeout',(CASE WHEN current_user='cp_reader' THEN LEAST($1::bigint,5000) ELSE $1 END)::text || 'ms',false) AS timeout_setting, set_config('default_transaction_read_only',CASE WHEN $2 THEN 'on' ELSE current_setting('default_transaction_read_only') END,false) AS read_only_setting
